source.rationale: THE FORWARD-COMPATIBILITY FIXTURE. It exercises a path that is UNREACHABLE ON LIVE TODAY: the live parser (sub-semantic-parser XTODTw @ 177c50a9) has ZERO occurrences of company_pick, so nothing on live can populate escalation.company_pick and the `else if (cpickRow)` arm can never be entered. It is here so the consumer is already proven correct on the day the parser half lands, and so a later edit to the arm fails loudly instead of silently. State is IDENTICAL to company-pick-absent-inert.json except for the one added key: same team on both sides, no preferred_assignee_id, the same two-entry routing_roster_plan. With company_pick = 'sorento' the pool is the roster plan (non-empty, so routing_companies is not consulted), the name key 'sorento' matches exactly one row, and the arm sends that row's axes VERBATIM - company_id and company_name from the Sorento row, brand_code 'sorento' - with routing_source 'company_pick'. Without the key the same state yields multi_company_unpicked / all axes null, which is the A/B the pair exists to state.
